title.native: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー Season 3

synonyms: สาวม้าโมเอะ ภาค 3

node.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside.

Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

__Height:__ 150 cm

Unbeatable and adorable! A happy hoppin' racer.

A bright, bubbly Umamusume with a natural knack for racing. She's long looked up to the student council president, [Symboli Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/140844/Symboli-Rudolf), and this admiration serves as her ultimate motivation in becoming the number one racer. Fans can't get enough of Teio's boundless confidence, and have lovingly dubbed her upbeat march the "Teio Step."

__Height:__ 145 cm

Bringer of misfortune? This racer pursues her dreams despite her dreary outlook.

A timid Umamusume, she is under the impression that any misfortune befalling those around her is entirely her fault, when really, it's just bad timing. Nevertheless, she is determined to eradicate this supposed jinx of hers. She loves reading picture books in her spare time, especially "The Blue Rose of Good Fortune."

__Height:__ 159 cm

The crown jewel of the prestigious Mejiro clan. A classy and poised young lady.

Born into a family of racing legends, Mejiro McQueen is a long-distance runner who is the envy of her peers. She has class and decorum befitting her prestige, and is determined to take first at the Tenno Sho, like many Mejiro racers before her. On her days off, she enjoys having afternoon tea with the many other residents of the Mejiro estate.

__Height:__ 170 cm

Wild and unpredictable, this golden runner is unlike anybody else!

An unpredictable firebrand born with an extra helping of free spirit. She's prone to some dramatic swings in mood and motivation—one moment she could be setting up an elaborate punchline, and in the next you would be hard-pressed to get her to move. She seems to get along with anyone and everyone, but it is unclear just how she views her bonds with others. Truly, one could call her Tracen's greatest mischief-maker.

alternative: Supreme Ruler of the Century's End

node.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

The pompous star of the stage. Her laugh fills the room!

Opera O's behavior is always over-exaggerated, sometimes loudly, and you will often hear her proclaiming her greatness in some way or other. She seriously believes that those who do not know their own beauty and strength are unhappy, and she works tirelessly every day to enlighten them. She's friends with and admired by [Meisho Doto ](https://anilist.co/character/211557/Meishou-Dotou).

A member of Team Rigil as well as rival to [Narita Top Road ](https://anilist.co/character/273332/Narita-Top-Road) and [Admire Vega ](https://anilist.co/character/273331/Admire-Vega).

__Height:__ 161 cm

The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier.

An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates with Special Week and many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality.

__Height:__ 140 cm (Season 2) / 162 cm (Season 3)
__Team:__ Spica

Her smile brightens the room. A festival-loving bucket of sunshine.

Ever bright and cheerful, she loves festivals more than anyone else. Her innate altruism makes her unable to ignore a person in need, and she's always ready to lend an ear. Her bottomless kindness has earned her the admiration of those around her, but when she gets too excited, her words take on a certain festival flair. With a smile as bright as the sun, she continues to run towards the dazzling horizon, hoping that she will discover her true dream along the way.

__Height:__ 140 cm

Her comebacks are lightning fast. Showin' 'em what Naniwa girls are made of!

A small girl with an unmistakable Kansai dialect. Despite her size, she's a bundle of energy and is always ready for action, be it in a race or in everyday life. She grew up in a less fortunate environment, but her power comes from her persistent spirit—you won't find much getting her down. She and the effortlessly funny [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) make for a good comedic duo.

__Height:__ 158 cm

Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream.

Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

Always chasing shadows... Quite the mysterious Umamusume.

A mysterious girl who blends in with the shadows... and speaks with them. She can often be found sticking close to the walls, tracing odd patterns with her fingertips. According to her, however, she's always with her "friend." She enjoys sipping a nice cup of coffee, as gulping it down too quickly hurts her stomach.

Extremely haughty. Her pride extends to the heavens!

An Umamusume with an unbreakable spirit, King Halo is ready to overcome any challenge in order to be recognized by all as a first-class lady. Despite their strained relationship, she hopes to one day be recognized by her mother—a first-rate Umamusume and designer—and prove herself as a daughter. Yet to her gaggle of admirers at the academy, there's no doubt in their minds that she's already worthy of the title of "King," and they do not hesitate to regularly hail her as such.

__Height:__ 140 cm

No matter how many times she falls, this girl always picks herself back up!

She's on a losing streak... but she never gives up! While she may not be the most skilled, she experienced the excitement of racing back in Kochi and wanted more. While she completely flunked Tracen's entrance exam, her admissions officer was nonetheless impressed when they spoke by her boundless possibility—which she spreads to all the Umamusume around her. 

She is based on the internationally-famed racehorse of the same name with a record of 0 wins and 113 losses.

__Height:__ 157 cm

Don't expect much from her. This Umamusume is super cynical.

An Umamusume of humble background with a penchant for being pessimistic. She tends to think of herself as a supporting character, and this causes her to shy away from high expectations—this sometimes leads to imperfect performances. She has quite the knack for cooking and cleaning due to her working-class upbringing, and does so whenever she has time. She's something of a familiar face among the seniors in her town.

__Height:__ 163 cm

Beyond arrogant! This hothead hates to lose.

Unyielding, strong-willed, and cheeky, she wants to be number one at everything she does. She usually plays the role of the perfect, mild-mannered honor student, but the truth is that she hates losing more than anything else. If it'll help her be number one, she'll go through any training—no matter how grueling. She sees her rather showy roommate Vodka as both her motivation and her rival.

__Height:__ 165 cm

The reigning Emperor. Her rule is absolute!

Well-versed in both ways of racing and leadership through her work leading the student body, she serves as the evenhanded president of the student council at Tracen Academy. She seeks to be a model Umamusume, and as such, is keenly aware of the example that she sets. Her dream is to foster a new era in which all Umamusume can live in true happiness. She is especially admired by Tokai Teio.

__Height:__ 146 cm

Turbo boost! This wild charger knows no limits!

A student brimming with youthful energy who just wants to run, run, run like crazy! She doesn't really know her own limits yet, so she has a tendency to hit them full-force, but she seems to be enjoying life on the wild side. She's a bit immature compared to the other runners her age, and she can be a bit selfish, but it's hard to fault her honest, whimsical personality.

__Height:__ 164 cm

In order to change her outlook and herself, this pessimist gives it her all.

Her self-esteem droops as low as her ears. Things never seem to go quite right for this clumsy girl. Even so, she's determined to change herself for the better and doesn't want to ever give up, all for the chance at securing a brighter future. She admires [T.M. Opera O](https://anilist.co/character/140845/TM-Opera-O)'s grandiose self-confidence.

__Height:__ 135 cm (Season 2) / 158 cm (Season 3)
__Team:__ Capella

Possesses a will harder than diamonds! She can handle any jinx!

Born to an affluent house, she was showered with love and affection growing up. This sheltered upbringing has made her somewhat naive, but her gentle, honest demeanor hides a diamond-hard resolve. She trudges on resolutely, determined to break the Satono family's jinx and bring honor to her family.

__Height:__ 157 cm

The lone star that shines brightest. She carries the weight of her immense resolve.

A somewhat gloomy Umamusume who tends to avoid company. A certain tragedy that took place early in her life affects her deeply, even making her racing activities seem like an attempt to atone. Though she doesn't intend it, her stoic pessimism garners the interest and concern of those around her, and she often gets caught up in the antics of T.M. Opera O, one of her racing peers. 

~!Admire Vega reveals that she was to be born with a twin sister, but that only one of them could survive until birth (presumably due to complications). Therefore she finds herself guilty of taking away her sister's right to run.!~

__Height:__ 155 cm

Straightforward and positive-thinking, this model student always gives 110 percent! But despite her efforts, her inner ditz often has her fumbling in crucial moments. The ups and downs balance out into results that are—according to her—completely average. She sometimes wishes she could be more like the strong personalities around her, but she's determined to charge through and find success her own way!

__Height:__ 156cm

Good vibes only! For real, for real! No cap! ☆ Who's ready to party? This racer!

"I'm so loud?! Well, DUH, if you're gonna do something, you gotta make it FUN! And if you wanna call that cringe, I'll just crank it up even louder! ♪" That's the mindset of this bright, chatty runner. Get ready for smilemaxxing and par-tays, 'cause she's in it to enjoy it. Helios is never one to turn down an invitation, and has a way of making every occasion a blast.

The North American Phantom Bird! A vivacious and quirky lucha libre.

A masked luchadora, she's always hyped up and ready to wrestle. She has ultimate confidence that she's the world's strongest Umamusume, and loves to proclaim that fact to anyone who'll lend her an ear. Her mask is a present from her pro wrestler father and she insists on keeping it on all the timeーno matter what. Her best friend and roommate, Grass Wonder, constantly scolds her for being too reckless. 

~!As a fast umamusume who came from America with winning streaks of six, she quickly earns a place as one of the favorites of the audiences. But she came to a first loss on her seventh race.!~

~!Later on, she went overseas to train for an upcoming race. She unfortunately lost against Broye in the race which made her strive harder to get faster and train even more.!~

**Height**: 160cm

Ambitious with a timid heart. Aiming to become a great Umamusume.

She's introverted, withdrawn, and has an inferiority complex about her talented older and younger sisters. She spends her time working hard to hopefully surpass them both one day, and have her own abilities acknowledged. She's not on bad terms with either of her siblings... but they both have a glamorous temperament, which makes her a bit out of place when they're together.

__Height:__ 168 cm

Motherly and kind, her presence is soothing.

No matter how bad you were, this racer will forgive and comfort you before spoiling you rotten. Her tendency towards leniency sometimes extends to herself. She values the growth of others over even her own personal gains. She is rivals with both Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross.

__Height:__ 165 cm

Headstrong and full of life! A roadster with a heart of gold.

Dedicated to being the coolest, this Umamusume tries her best to act like a delinquent. She takes after her motorcycle-loving father, emulating his hobbies and attitudes down to the letter. Her grandstanding nature sees her charge daringly into any challenge, never afraid of what she might face. She has a bit of a cat-and-dog relationship with her roommate, Daiwa Scarlet.

__Height:__ 155 cm

Does what she wants, when she wants. As free as a drifting cloud...

As one of the most easygoing girls you'll meet, she lives life at her own pace. But on the inside, she's quite the schemer, and her laziness is just an act to get others to let down their guard... sometimes. Her hobbies include taking afternoon naps and fishing. She also loves cats and is often seen curling up with them outside on the grass. She's classmates with [Special Week](https://anilist.co/character/125299/Special-Week).

__Height:__ 160 cm

Always follows commands! The cyborg Umamusume.

An Umamusume also known as the "Cyborg". She views the world through the lens of programming and databases, carrying out her objectives in an expressionless and robotic manner. Even so, she is not an emotionless machine—her constant training since her youth has simply resulted in less interactions with people, leading to her current personality. Underneath that robotic shell, she does indeed have feelings.

__Height:__ 163 cm

Fortune be with me! This charm-tastic Umamusume loves fortune-telling.

A fortune-telling fanatic and lover of the supernatural, she's content to leave the outcomes of races and many other things up to luck. If she's not divining for her own sake, then she's divining for someone else's. She places an immense faith in a revelation from a certain god stating that as long as she keeps running, the way forward will open up before her. The name of the cat shaped bag that she carries is "Miss Nya."

__Height:__ 155 cm

A shining star of pure cuteness! I need lots of love and attention, okay?

When you think of "cute," you think of Curren Chan, and when you think of Curren Chan, you think of the selfie goddess boasting over 3 million followers on Umastagram. Realizing just how adorable she was from the moment she was born, she's used her natural charm to bend her parents and seniors alike to her whims. Thanks to that, she is able to climb the social ladder of life with ease. To show everyone just how cute she is, she now aims for the top of the Twinkle Series.

Neat and sweet. Japanese at heart, she's back home from the U.S.

Though born in America, her parents' love of Japanese culture influenced her to also love all things to do with the country—to the point of being called the spitting image of the ideal Japanese beauty. She speaks in a friendly manner and is easy to get along with, but her will is firm. Her determination to win is second to none. She shares a room with her close friend, [El Condor Pasa](https://anilist.co/character/125303/El-Condor-Pasa).

__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Actions speak louder than words! A tough and stubborn lone wolf.

A member of team Rigil. A lone wolf of few words and ample strength, Narita Brian is feared throughout the academy due to both her personality and her performance on the turf. She has little interest in anything besides running, which she does only to quench her own endless thirst. Off the racecourse, she is [Biwa Hayahide's](https://anilist.co/character/174851/Biwa-Hayahide) little sister and, for some reason, a student council vice president.

__Height__: 143 cm

She's like your sweet little sister. She can't wait to grow up!

A rambunctious young genius of an Umamusume who seeks affection from everyone she meets. Having a pilot for a father, Mayano Top Gun often mixes aviation lingo into her speech. Her tendency to obsess over whatever new and exciting thing is in front of her betrays how far she is from becoming the mature, sophisticated lady of her dreams. However, she does possess incredible intuition and an almost supernatural sense of the right thing to do in any situation.

__Height:__ 152 cm

Aiming to be a mascot. An ephemeral eccentric girl.

She carries a Machan doll, and will approach any camera she sees. A particularly strange Umamusume, one of her hobbies is recording voice memos. Her dream is to become a mascot that spans the whole world. Behind her cloud-like fluffy words, it seems there may be a certain desire...?

__Height__: 158 cm

This class representative's gone wild! Full Speed Bakushiiiin!

A class representative who'll rush recklessly into any situation. Once her mind is set on something, she'll bakushin dash straight to her goal—often causing more chaos than she helps resolve. She never acts out of self-righteousness, however, and tends to feel downhearted if no one is asking for her assistance. Her aptitude for sprinting is quite overwhelming, and she is confident she can outrun anyone with unmatched speed.

__Height:__ 171 cm

A fiery intellectual. Logic is her weapon!

A theorist through and through, she breaks down any problem systemically. Theory-driven as she is, she values practical application, so her methods never end up as just talk. She has honed her ability to compete with the overwhelming talent of her sister, Narita Brian. She is good friends with schoolmates Narita Taishin and Winning Ticket.
Trainer of Team Spica.

A friendly girl born in the U.S.

A cowgirl with a heart as big as her might. As friendly as they come, she's one heck of a hug machine. She tends to get lonely, however, so perhaps that's why she's one heck of a party planner too! Specializing in sprints, her powerful dash has even caught the eye of her friend, [Silence Suzuka](https://anilist.co/character/125298/Silence-Suzuka).

__Height:__ 160 cm

Let's have a good time! This Umamusume is upbeat and always there for friends.

A young lady from the renowned Mejiro family, though you might not guess it from her casual, friendly attitude. She's quite a socialite and notices even little changes in the people around her, but having such talented relatives caused her to develop a bit of an inferiority complex. Eventually, she found a way to handle those feelings—run, run, and run some more, smiling all the way. As long as she keeps running ahead, she'll one day forge her own destiny.

__Height:__ 167 cm

She's gonna be the biggest star in the world! A charismatic Umamusume of great ambitions.

"The brightest star out there is Sirius." With unmatched confidence and the prowess to back it up, she dreams of winning big on the world stage. Her rough mannerisms and crude way of speaking exude a toughness and charisma that attracts many to her. She despises lies and ambiguity, so everyone knows that she means exactly what she says. In other words, she's a natural-born star in every sense.

__Height:__ 162 cm

Gentle but persistent. A cherry blossom blooming through winter.

She's a positive Umamusume with an indomitable spirit, who's cheerful, optimistic, and unfazed by every obstacle. She was born with weak legs, and has been plagued by injuries, but she gets back up every time she gets knocked down. She has special feelings for her classmate, [Narita Brian](https://anilist.co/character/140843/Narita-Brian), and she hopes to beat her someday.

You wanna go? One-on-one! The dorm leader everyone knows and loves.

A hot-blooded racer who loves nothing more than a one-on-one fight. Though seen by most as a fierce competitor, she has the good grace to congratulate her opponents should they win. She is the rather hot-tempered leader of Miho Dormitory, and is proficient at cooking, cleaning, and laundry. Although generally reliable in just about any situation, you probably shouldn't mention the notion of ghosts or thunder around her.

In Uma Musume: Pretty Derby she´s member of Team Rigil.

The coolly calculating Empress. Highly gifted and ambitious.

The vice president of Tracen Academy's student council, known to the other students as the "Empress". The daughter of an accomplished racer, she constantly strives to live up to her mother's racing prowess and ability to guide others. To this end, she has joined her friend and confidant, Symboli Rudolf, in the student council. Despite her strict schedule, she still makes time to tend the flowers in the garden.

__Height:__ 145 cm

Cool and matter-of-fact! Her slight frame gives her an unexpected advantage.

A rebellious soul who is sharp as a tack. She was often teased for her small stature, so now she runs to prove her true abilities. Her coarse nature is a by-product of her disdain of being looked down upon. She is good friends with schoolmates [Winning Ticket](https://anilist.co/character/174852/Winning-Ticket) and [Biwa Hayahide](https://anilist.co/character/174851/Biwa-Hayahide).

**Height:** 166cm

The most powerful blood flows through her body. The product of a prestigious family.

An elite Umamusume with a promising future, born from a prestigious family known for producing many excellent athletic Umamusume. She is usually quite serious and stoic, but when a race is in front of her, her fighting spirit takes over and she shows her wild side. She has been close friends with [Air Groove](https://anilist.co/character/140846/Air-Groove) from a very young age.

**Height:** 156cm

Vivlos is a devilishly cute young lady. She's the youngest of three sisters, and has been a spoiled brat since she was a child, because of her family's wealth. She has been fascinated by Dubai since she went there on vacation, and longed to live a celebrity life in a luxurious country. Her goal is to run a race in Dubai, using her natural talent and great sense of timing as her weapons.

__Height__: 168 cm

Always takes the logical approach! A brilliant but eccentric racer..

A rebel who only trusts the data she has collected. If she is winning a race, it is due entirely to her calculations and is never due to chance. No matter how many times she's calculated it, she comes up seven centimeters short of winning the Triple Crown, and is currently searching for any possible error in her calculations to prove that it can be done.

__Height:__ 145 cm

Never hold back your feelings! This girl wears her heart on her sleeve.

Loud and proud, she's a straightforward soul who can get along well with anyone. She loves all sports, but holds special admiration for the Japanese Derby, a race that she dreams of winning one day, no matter the cost. She, Narita Taishin, and Biwa Hayahide are inseparable.

**Height**: 163cm

Turf Magician! An elite sister you can rely on.

She is a cheerful and determined older sister who lives in both Hong Kong and Japan. She's also one of the talented members of the Satono family, and carries the family's high expectations. She has a personality that burns more brightly in the face of adversity, and sometimes solves problems as brilliantly as magic.

__Height:__ 139 cm

A plucky umamusume who is a true child of Edo though she actually comes from the countryside. She’s small, but possesses infinite power and stamina. Her strength was unmatched in her local series, and she was known as the “Downtown Superstar.” She’s the kind of person who gets into haggling fights over a buying or selling price, and isn’t afraid to show off her strength during a race. Oguri Cap and Super Creek are her classmates, and they each mutually respect each others’ abilities.

__Height:__ 170 cm

An international student from abroad who is emotionally unaffected and quiet, and who places a high priority on efficiency and winning percentage when it comes to racing– she is often feared because of her "workman's" appearance, but she is obsessed with results in order to fulfill her duty to those who have been closely involved with her. She is obsessed with results... In other words, she has a noble spirit.

**Height:** 158cm

She is a confident young lady who takes pride in the fact that she deserves the title of "Queen," which is the highest position in the world. She is the eldest of three sisters and strives to set a good example for both of her sisters. She has been given a high-level education in a wealthy family and is very talented and accomplished. However, she has been cursed by the number "2", and has a difficult time winning.

__Height:__ 163 cm

Control freak. A skilled Umamusume who can adapt to anything.

A straight-laced Umamusume with the organizational prowess of a secretary. She expertly manages her condition with cool, collected assessments, but is surprisingly personable despite her strictness. She's fiercely determined to keep herself running for as long as possible—inspired by a time in the past when she could not...

__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")

A sheltered lady excited to make memories that will last a lifetime.

A lady of a distinguished family that is rumored to be royalty, she has come to Tracen as an exchange student from Ireland. Perhaps due to a sheltered childhood, she's very curious about everything, which can lead to some sticky situations. She hopes to make a lot of memories while at the academy.

__Height:__ 157 cm

She wants to change! This Umamusume bears the scars of her past.

While cool and reticent, she remains tense in many social situations, especially if men are present. Though she was raised in the prestigious Mejiro household, where visitors are never rare, she has nonetheless led a very sheltered life. Perhaps because of this, she can come off cold to strangers, but those who take time to talk to her realize that she is not quite as uptight as she first seems.

__Zodiac:__ Aries
__Height:__ 163 cm

Nothing beats a good workout! Even the sweat of her brow is earnest and pure.

A sporty girl who loves a good workout. Although born into the prestigious Mejiro family, her animated personality somewhat betrays that fact. She has something of an inferiority complex surrounding her childhood friend, Mejiro McQueen, and wishes to be as fast and pretty as her. Though physically strong, her heart is rather delicate.

__Height:__ 160cm

A little mysterious? Scratch that.. Very mysterious? An out-of-this-world Umamusume.

A diligent Umamusume with a clear mind. The only problem is, she can't communicate normally. She's clever to a fault, sometimes acting in ways and saying things that are hard to understand. Thanks to that, the people around her sometimes call her an "alien" ...?

__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Big and generous... portions? Get some more buono in your life! ♪

A magnanimous chef who loves to feed others just as much as she loves to eat. She is a gentle soul who wishes to see the smiling faces of those around her. She was born abroad, and has come to be somewhat of a sumo fanatic, but ultimately decided upon a life on the track over one in the ring. It seems that her childhood dream was to become like a chanko hot pot.

**Height**: 161cm

The race is her ensemble! A music-loving, artistic, Umamusume.

Her racing is an ensemble with the earth, and the girls in the race are her musical partners. She's a natural artist who loves music more than anything else, and isn't afraid to say that "playing the most wonderful sound in a race" is her true calling. She's a very passionate person, and sometimes makes flirtatious advances towards her rivals whom she admires. She's also a violinist, and her favorite flower is the Flowering Dogwood.

__Height:__ 159 cm

Relaxed and patient. An Umamusume that never gives up.

She has a very docile personality, and takes good care of those around her. She has earned a reputation of reminding people of their grandmothers. However, when a race is about to start, her demeanor changes and she pushes herself to the limit with an intense fighting spirit.
A live broadcast announcer for races in the Twinkle Series.

__Height__: 156 cm

She's gonna be a real city girl! Just a hardwork'n girl from the country.

A simple girl from the Iwate countryside, she would often lend a hand on the family farm. Yet despite her humble country background, her true desire is to be a cosmopolitan city girl and compete in the Twinkle Series. Her rural northern upbringing has made her a sincere Umamusume who doesn't back down from a challenge. She sees Gold City as that very ideal.

**Height:** 165cm

Rickey☆Lucky☆A Caring Feng Shui Girl☆

A bright and cheerful person generally stated to be a very lucky girl. Her knowledge of Feng Shui goes deep, and is all truly real. She has adopted Feng Shui not just in her daily life, but also while training and during races. She wants to make everyone happy with her Feng Shui power! Not only that, but her advice for bringing good fortune seems to be well received...

__Height:__ 141 cm

Victory is a must. An Umamusume of a brilliant family.

She's the daughter of a "Noble Family" whose name is well-known around the world. She always tries to behave in a noble manner, befitting of her family name, and her solemn words and actions often give the impression of being somewhat unapproachable.
Mihono Bourbon's Trainer, whom she refers to as "Master."

__Height:__ 135cm

Her smile brightens the room. She's a very thoughtful and kind Umamusume.

A softspoken, adorable and innocent Umamusume. Though she's still a bit unsure of her future, she aims to bloom into an elegant lady. She's very thoughtful, and even if she's caught up with her own responsibilities, she's always considerate of those around her. The season of full-bloom is surely just around the corner.
Special Week's Adoptive Mother

__Height__: 144 cm

The flames of justice burn bright in her heart! Feel the heat of this hero!

Biko Pegasus dreams of being just like Carrot Ranger from her favorite show! She was inspired by her amazing racing form after watching a certain episode, and now she even acts the part around the academy! She's going to be a while in that toy store... 

A rascal horse girl who hates losing. Though she’s small in stature, she’s gutsy by nature and will challenge anyone to a race. She loves anime and tokusatsu, and someday hopes to become a hero herself, so that she can give her own fans hopes and dreams. Every day she devotes herself to developing her Neo Critical Art/Finishing Move. She and Hishi Akebono work together to form a scrappy duo. She’s always getting heartfelt (and bone-shattering) hugs from Hishi Akebono.

**Height:** 159cm

Make a legend! Aiming to be the strongest from a peculiar perspective.

A smart Umamusume that excels at working independently. In order to become the "strongest" Umamusume, winning over people's hearts, she diligently studies how to appeal to fans in addition to her racing. In front of fans, she acts hardworking, but does not let that character show for others. She is truly a demon of self-production.

__Height:__ 162cm

Running for Tomakomai, a Realist Local Idol

A local idol hailing from Tomakomai! Her love for her hometown earned her the name "Tomakomai's Minister of Tourism" among the townspeople. She's always going through trial and error so she can use her running and lives to promote Tomakomai. Being a little too serious is one of her weaknesses.

__Height:__ 158cm

A cheerful, polite, and strong-willed horse girl who grew up carelessly in the harsh yet beautiful nature.
~!On a big plot twist, River Light becomes the winner of the Grand Prix on Season 3 Episode 5!~

alternative: Dansei Announcer (男性アナウンサー)

node.description: Male Annnouncer is present in nearly every episode of Uma Musume: Pretty Derby Season 3, where he co-casts both prior to the race and during it, always alongside a female announcer that has green hair. He typically offers colorful commentary on the Uma Musume lineup of the race at hand, further immersing the viewer into the race.
